tools.name: find_grant_opportunities
tools.description: Searches Grants.gov for open or forecasted federal grant opportunities by keyword, eligibility, agency, category, posting date and closing date. Returns up to 30 rows per page, per-item errors, and XLSX pipeline-tracker and ICS deadline downloads. Covers federal opportunities on Grants.gov only; pri

tools.name: show_grant_details
tools.description: Reads up to 20 federal opportunity numbers or numeric IDs from Grants.gov and returns details, per-item errors, and XLSX and ICS downloads for a pasted shortlist. Covers grant details and closing dates only; it does not write, submit or track grant applications.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_grant_opportunities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
